children: Stellantis N.V. (MIL:STLAM) is reshaping strategy: a five‑year plan reallocates Europe capex to Fiat/Peugeot and North America to Jeep/Ram while launching U.S. extended‑range EVs, managing recalls and production pauses, negotiating Canadian contracts, and reshuffling senior marketing roles.
: Stellantis (STLAM) five‑year plan: Europe capex focused on Fiat and Peugeot; North America prioritizes Jeep and Ram; Lancia ties closer to Fiat; DS links closer to Citroën.
Stellantis N.V. To Launch Extended-Range EVs
: Stellantis (STLAM) will launch extended-range EVs in the U.S.: Jeep Grand Wagoneer EREV late 2026/early 2027, then Ram 1500 REV. Fully electric with gasoline range extender.
Stellantis N.V. Recalling 328,381 U.S. Chrysler Vehicles
: Stellantis (STLAM) recalled 328,381 U.S. Chrysler vehicles over rear coil springs that may detach while driving, raising crash risk; recall initiated to fix affected cars.
: Stellantis N.V. (STLAM) and Unifor began talks on a new collective agreement affecting 9,000+ Canadian Stellantis workers, starting negotiations on contract renewal terms across multiple plants.
Stellantis N.V. Pauses Mirafiori Fiat 500 Production
: Stellantis (STLAM) will pause Mirafiori Fiat 500 production Sept 2–4 due to engine component shortages; nearby Teksid plant output is below levels needed for hybrid demand.
Stellantis N.V. Leads Italy August Market
: Stellantis N.V. (STLAM) led Italy’s August new‑car market, posting a 6.1% year‑over‑year sales rise and a 27.1% market share, per Transport Ministry data.
Stellantis N.V. Rehires Belloni; François Becomes Advisor
: Stellantis (STLAM) rehired Belloni as marketing head after a stint as Renault global CMO; Olivier François shifts from brand roles to serve as strategic advisor.
